verdict.rationale: LobeChat stores chat data locally by default and offers self-hosting via Docker Compose, which effectively lets a user control where data physically resides by choosing their own server location; there is no explicit cloud region/residency selector for the hosted service. missing for 10: an explicit region/residency selection feature in the hosted LobeChat/LobeHub cloud offering, and any compliance documentation (e.g., GDPR/data-residency certifications) confirming regional storage guarantees.
